text: となりの　ひと…　おとこ　なのに　なさけないわ

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', with a feeling of complaint; after a noun it needs な in front. おとこ　なのに = 'even though he's a man'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end of a sentence is a soft, womanly way to voice a feeling. なさけないわ = 'he's so pathetic'.
